source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of use case diagrams (PDF 20-22).

blocks.text: Use case diagrams UML ka bunyadi hissa hain jo dikhate hain ke users, jinhein actors kehte hain, nizam ke saath kin tareeqon se taamul karte hain. Yeh user ke nuqta-e-nazar se nizam ki functionality ki tasweer dete hain, aur requirements aur users aur nizam ke taamul pehchanne mein madad dete hain.

blocks.title: Use case
blocks.text: Use case user (actor) aur nizam ke darmiyan kisi khaas maqsad tak pohanchne ke taamulat ka bayan hai. Har use case user ke nuqta-e-nazar se ek mukammal workflow hai, jo kisi khaas kaam ko poora karne ke qadmon ki tafseel deta hai.

items: Functional requirements pakarna: pehchanna aur darj karna ke nizam ko kya karna hai.
User ke taamul samajhna: mukhtalif users nizam kaise istemal karenge.
Planning aur testing: development ki planning aur nizam ke kaam jaanchne ke test cases banana.
Actors pehchanein: users ki qismein, log ya doosre nizam, jo nizam se taamul karenge.
Maqasid tay karein: har actor ko nizam se kya hasil karna hai.
Taamulat ka khaka: un maqasid tak pohanchne wale taamulat bayan karein; aham nateeja dene wala har taamul mumkina use case hai.
Use cases ki tasdeeq: stakeholders ke saath jaaiza le kar dekhein ke zaroori kaam aur taamulat shamil hain.

blocks.text: Figure 1.9 mein library system ka use case diagram do actors, librarian aur student, dikhata hai, dono nizam ki had ke andar Borrow book aur Return book use cases se jure hain. Kitab ki online shopping platform wali class activity mein actors customer, administrator aur delivery personnel hain, aur use cases browse products, cart mein items daalna, khareedari karna, product listings sambhalna, orders process karna, customer ke sawalat nimtana aur delivery status update karna hain.

blocks.alt: Simple Use case diagram unwan wale lambe dabbe (system boundary) mein do baizawi shaklein (ovals) hain: Borrow book aur Return book. Dabbe ke bahar baen taraf actor Librarian aur daen taraf actor Student khare hain; dono ek ek lakeer se dono ovals se jure hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.9: Library system ka use case diagram (kitab ki Figure 1.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Use case diagrams ka maqsad kya hai (MCQ 10)? Use case diagram ka maqsad samjhaiye (short question 6).
blocks.explanation: Nizam ki functional requirements pehchanna aur darj karna, option (b). Use case diagram dikhata hai ke nizam kaun istemal karta hai (actors) aur har ek us se kya hasil karta hai (use cases), to yeh zaroori kaam pakarta, development ki planning mein madad deta aur test cases ki bunyad deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Long question 4: online banking system ke use case diagram ke actors aur use cases bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Actors: customer, bank staff (aur shayad bairooni nizam ke taur par payment network). Customer ke use cases: log in, balance dekhna, statement dekhna, paisa muntaqil karna, bills ada karna. Staff ke use cases: account kholna, customer ki tasdeeq, qarzon ki manzoori, shikayat nimtana. Actors ko nizam ke dabbe ke bahar bana kar har ek ko andar ke use-case ovals se joriye.

items: Use case diagram: actors aur woh use cases (maqasid) jo woh nizam se hasil karte hain; functional requirements, taamul, planning aur testing.
Qadam: actors pehchanna, maqasid, taamulat, tasdeeq; Fig. 1.9 library (librarian, student; kitab udhaar, wapas).
